name: q2_largest_filer_per_class
title: Largest assignee of each architecture
caption: The architectures of 20 designs or more: assignees, effective number of assignees (1 / Σ sᵢ²), the largest assignee over all years and the highest share one assignee holds inside a single priority cohort of 10 or more of the architecture's aircraft.
read: The effective number of assignees is how many equally sized assignees would give the same concentration.
